supplement.version: current EMA linked product information; no printed revision number

indication: Adult progressive unresectable/metastatic well-differentiated pancreaticNET; not NEC or all-siteNET.

schedule.cycle: 28day review cycle with no scheduled drug-free week
schedule.food: Same time daily; consistently with or withoutfood; swallow capsules whole withwater
schedule.missed_dose: No additionaldose; usual prescribed dose the nextday

baseline: Cardiac assessment/echo/MUGA if clinically indicated or cardiac history
monitoring.disease_assessment: Imaging and any tumour-marker testing are individualized; no mandatory universal interval in this source.
ema_supplement: Baseline urinalysis and monitor new/worsening proteinuria (page7)
Consider preventive dental review, especially IVbisphosphonates (pages7–8)

support.antidiarrhoeals: May be required; follow team prescription
support.automatic_prophylaxis: No routine G-CSF or antimicrobial prescription specified

patient_priorities: Early report of painful hands/feet: even first grade2 requires a clinician-directed pause.
Contact team for diarrhoea/vomiting/dehydration, mouth symptoms and reduced oral intake.
Urgent clinical help for chest pain, breathlessness, collapse, severe headache/visual disturbance, significant bleeding, severe abdominal pain, or progressive blistering/peeling rash.
Diabetic patients need a glucose plan; symptomatic low glucose requires treatment and clinician-directed temporary interruption.
Discuss planned surgery/dental procedures and all prescription/OTC/herbal products; avoid grapefruit and StJohn’swort.
Skin/hair discoloration may occur; do not confuse cosmetic change with painful blistering/severe mucosal rash.
Treatment continuation, dose changes and restart follow the specialist team; avoid a wallet stamp that implies a fixed total number of daily cycles.
clinical_limits: Child-PughC NCCP/EMA conflict requires specialist resolution; do not put a dose calculator into patient material.
Keep cardiac monitoring clinically indicated, TFT every12weeks and BP eachattendance distinct from pre-cycle bloods.
NCCP states minimal–low emesis, no premedication; do not import a generic cytotoxic prescription.
